Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 11
Reason for Mistake: Incorrect logical comparison of birth years. The Planner correctly identified the birth years (Pupi Avati: 1938, Boaz Yakin: 1965) but erroneously concluded that Boaz Yakin was born "first" (earlier). In chronological terms, 1938 is earlier than 1965, meaning Pupi Avati was born first. The Planner reversed the chronological order, likely confusing "earlier" with "later" or misinterpreting the magnitude of the numbers in the context of "born first."
